transcript.answer: Each skill's SKILL.md must end with a `## Help` section. The body of that section must be fenced by `<!-- lore-help:begin -->` and `<!-- lore-help:end -->`, with each marker alone on its own line. Markers are matched anchored to the start of a line, so mid-sentence mentions don't count. The block must contain the required `**Summary.**` and `**Usage:**` lines. It may also contain the optional `**Use when.**`, `**Not for.**`, `**Examples**` and `**Related:**` lines. `scripts/check-skill-help.sh` (the `skill-help` PR check) checks that the block is present and has this shape. A skill without the block fails the check. I did not read the script itself, so any checks beyond these are unknown to me.

judgements.reason: The answer names the fenced Help block with the begin/end markers, the required Summary and Usage lines, and says scripts/check-skill-help.sh fails a skill without it; its extra details do not contradict the gold answer.
